subject: Clarify pass-through of marketplace credits and SLA implications for Order Form
messages:
From: Jane Parker <ops@resellco-marketplace.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Willis <legal@resellco-marketplace.io>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Question — Marketplace credits pass-through for Order Form

Hi Marissa / Ben,

Thanks for the quick turnaround on the proposed order form (attached). Before we sign, our finance team needs confirmation on how marketplace credits will flow through to the reseller invoice. Two quick questions:

1) If a customer redeems a marketplace credit (promo or cloud credits), do those credits reduce the amount ResellCo owes Redwood (i.e., a pass-through offset on your invoice), or do they remain on the marketplace settlement side?

2) Is there a guaranteed time window for applying credits against invoices (billing cycle vs settlement)? We have customers who expect credits to appear same-month and our accounting needs to know timing so we can reconcile.

Attaching the proposed Order Form so legal can mark up. Can you confirm whether you need MSA language changes or whether an Order Form line item is sufficient?

Thanks,
Jane Parker
Head of Marketplace Operations
ResellCo Marketplace
Attachments: Proposed_OrderForm_ResellCo_20270510.pdf (pdf)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Jane Parker <ops@resellco-marketplace.io>, Tom Willis <legal@resellco-marketplace.io>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 14:30:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Question — Marketplace credits pass-through for Order Form

Marissa / team —

Quick legal read and recommendations:

1) Default approach: Include a narrowly tailored Order Form provision that defines "Marketplace Credits" and specifies that Redeemed Credits will be treated as a "Settlement Offset" applied to amounts invoiced by Redwood to ResellCo, provided ResellCo provides supporting settlement evidence within X days.

Suggested language (high level):
- "Customer Eligible Credits" means credits issued by a cloud marketplace that are applied to a Customer's subscription for Redwood services. Redwood agrees to treat documented Customer Eligible Credits as a pass-through Settlement Offset against amounts invoiced to ResellCo, subject to ResellCo providing evidentiary settlement reports within thirty (30) days of redemption.

2) MSA change: If ResellCo wants broader ongoing pass-through treatment (all marketplace adjustments without evidence), we should do a narrow MSA amendment. For now, Order Form language + proof requirement will reduce accounting risk.

3) Timing: We should state an explicit window (e.g., credits submitted within 30 days will be applied to the next invoice; credits submitted after 30 days at Redwood's discretion / subject to reconciliation). Aligns with our revenue recognition.

4) Accounting fields: We will need a mapping table from marketplace settlement line items to Redwood invoice line items (SKU mapping + timestamp). Please have Soojin provide this.

I've put redlines in the attached doc (MSA_redline_karthik_20270511.docx). I kept the language tight to avoid opening up broad liability.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
Attachment: MSA_redline_karthik_20270511.docx (docx)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jane Parker <ops@resellco-marketplace.io>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 16:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Question — Marketplace credits pass-through for Order Form

All — adding operational context from the marketplace side so accounting can reconcile: 

- Marketplaces commonly settle on a T+30 to T+45 cadence. That means credit redemptions and settlement files often arrive one to two billing cycles after the customer redeems.
- For pass-through we need:
  * Settlement file format (CSV) with redemption ID, customer email, SKU, credit amount
  * Mapping table that maps marketplace SKU -> Redwood SKU/plan
  * An agreed SLA for evidence delivery (we recommend 30 days)

I've attached a simple diagram that shows the flow we typically support (BillingFlowDiagram.png). Practically, we can accept a short Order Form clause and the settlement evidence requirement — that keeps the MSA clean.

Operational ask for ResellCo: can you send one month of settlement files so our billing ops can validate mapping? If yes, we can confirm how credits will hit the next invoice (partial offset vs full line-item credit).

-Soojin Lee
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Attachment: BillingFlowDiagram.png (png)

From: Jane Parker <ops@resellco-marketplace.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Willis <legal@resellco-marketplace.io>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Question — Marketplace credits pass-through for Order Form

Marissa / team — thanks for the quick review and the suggested wording, that looks workable. A couple of follow-ups from our side: 

- We'll pull one month of settlement files (May) and share by EOD 13 May.
- Can you confirm whether the Order Form will include a checkbox/line item to opt into "Marketplace Credits Pass-Through" or whether you prefer a sentence in the commercial terms? Our procurement prefers a visible checkbox.
- On SLA: our customers expect credits to be reflected on the same billing month where possible. If settlements are T+45 we may need a provisional credit workflow at our upstream billing layer; would Redwood accept a reconciliation model (provisional offset followed by true-up on settlement)?

We can also loop Tom (legal) for any final redline on the Order Form once you provide text.

Thanks —
Jane
Attachments: PO_ResellCo_4567.pdf (pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Question — Marketplace credits pass-through for Order Form

Thanks everyone — good progress. Quick confirm and next steps: 

1) We will add a concise Order Form provision with the defined term "Customer Eligible Credits" and a 30-day evidentiary requirement (per Karthik). Text will include: credits submitted within 30 days will be applied to the next invoice; thereafter credits subject to reconciliation.
2) Soojin / ops: please validate mapping with one month of settlement files — target delivery 2027-05-13.
3) Karthik: please convert your redline into a short Order Form clause and share by EOD 2027-05-12 (we'll attach it to the Order Form v3).
4) Ben / Finance: please prep a note on how provisional offsets would be handled in our AR workflow if ResellCo wants a provisional credit model.

I'll upload OrderForm_v3_marked.pdf with the new clause once Karthik posts the clause. Jane — we'll aim to get a final shared doc for Tom to sign by Friday.

Best,
